title: Artwork/Assets Questions
author: SenhorRicky
selftext:
I've recently started developing an FPS game using Claude + Godot.

I've made some great progress so far, implementing various gameplay systems, gore mechanics, and other features. I've also completed the layouts for my first two levels, which I'm really happy with.

However, I have a couple of questions I'm hoping someone with more experience can help me with.

1. Level Design and Environmental Detail

I provided Claude with my level layouts, and it managed to build them accurately. However, everything is still very basic, consisting mostly of rough shapes, placeholder models, and simple geometry.

What's the best approach to turning these layouts into detailed, polished environments? Would you recommend purchasing asset packs and having Claude integrate them, or is it better to have Claude build and detail the environments itself?

I'm assuming the latter could potentially use a massive number of tokens.

2. Character Creation and Weapon Rigging

I've been using Meshy.ai to generate my characters, but getting them properly rigged and holding weapons has been an absolute nightmare.

I've encountered issues with broken meshes, incorrect hand positioning, weapons not aligning properly, and various other rigging problems.

What's the best workflow for creating custom characters and rigging them with weapons so that everything works correctly in Godot?

I'd really appreciate any advice here.
